items.name: whatiuse-base
items.title: whatiuse Base
items.description: Inter, semantic monochrome tokens, global accessibility defaults, and the documented cascade contract.

items.name: whatiuse-tailwind
items.title: whatiuse Tailwind Bridge
items.description: Optional Tailwind CSS v4 semantic utility mapping backed by the same whatiuse tokens.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Compact action hierarchy with loading-state geometry.

whatiuse.useWhen: The user needs to start or confirm a discrete action.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Navigation is the intent. Use a link that can still look like a button.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Accessible square icon action with tooltip support.

whatiuse.useWhen: A familiar icon can represent a frequent action in a constrained area.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The icon is ambiguous without explanation. Prefer a labelled Button.

items.name: field
items.title: Field & Fieldset
items.description: Accessible labels, guidance, validation, and grouped form semantics.

whatiuse.useWhen: A control needs a persistent label, supporting guidance, validation, or grouping semantics.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The content is not form input or the label would only repeat nearby visible context.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One text-entry boundary with contextual addons and compact actions.

whatiuse.useWhen: An addon or action belongs inside the same visual entry boundary as one text input.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The adjacent controls perform unrelated work or several inputs form a compound value.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Presentational keyboard hints for keys, chords, and sequences.

whatiuse.useWhen: A visible hint explains a real keyboard shortcut or key sequence.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The key is interactive on its own or no working shortcut exists.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Related actions with shared rhythm and optional joined geometry.

whatiuse.useWhen: Two or more related actions benefit from shared alignment or joined geometry.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Actions are unrelated, one action dominates an entire form, or arrow-key navigation is expected.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Compact frequently used controls with roving keyboard navigation.

whatiuse.useWhen: A compact set of frequent peer controls benefits from one arrow-navigable region.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Actions are infrequent, form submission is the main task, or controls need explanatory copy.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Dense labelled input with hints, validation, and adornments.

whatiuse.useWhen: The user enters a short, unstructured value.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: A finite option set can be selected with less effort.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: Locale-aware bounded numeric input with direct entry and step controls.

whatiuse.useWhen: The value is numeric and stepping, bounds, or locale-aware formatting reduce entry errors.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The number is an identifier, phone number, postal code, or another string that is not mathematically stepped.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Compact single selection between visible peer views or presentation modes.

whatiuse.useWhen: Two to four short peer options should remain visible and switch immediately.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Options are numerous, require descriptions, or submit later as part of a form.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Calendar & Date Picker
items.description: Locale-aware date entry and calendar selection with shared validation.

whatiuse.useWhen: A date must be entered precisely while a calendar also makes nearby dates easier to inspect.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The value is relative prose, a date range, or a full scheduling workflow with time zones and recurrence.

whatiuse.useWhen: Several independent options may be selected together.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: A setting takes effect immediately. Use Switch for that case.

whatiuse.useWhen: Changing the setting should take effect immediately.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The change must be reviewed and submitted with a form.

whatiuse.useWhen: A concise label clarifies an otherwise understandable control.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The content is required to complete the task or contains actions.

whatiuse.useWhen: A small set of controls belongs next to its trigger.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The task requires full attention, long forms, or a destructive decision.

whatiuse.useWhen: Related actions need a compact, temporary container.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Options must remain visible for comparison or frequent access.

whatiuse.useWhen: A short, reversible task needs focused attention and a clear completion point.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The work can be completed inline, requires a long workflow, or demands an explicit consequential response. Use Alert Dialog for the latter.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Object-specific actions opened by right click, long press, or keyboard.

whatiuse.useWhen: A familiar object has secondary actions that benefit from right click or long press and also have a keyboard path.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The action is required, frequent, undiscoverable without instruction, or the trigger has no stable object boundary.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Edge-aligned focused panel with modal focus and spatial context.

whatiuse.useWhen: A focused task needs more room than a Popover but the originating page should remain spatially legible.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The task is a short anchored choice, a full destination, or a gesture-driven drawer with snap points.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Explicit modal response for consequential or irreversible actions.

whatiuse.useWhen: A consequential action must interrupt the task and requires an explicit response.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The action is safely reversible with Undo or ordinary information is being displayed.

whatiuse.useWhen: Peer views of the same object can switch without navigation.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The sections form a sequence or users need to compare them simultaneously.

whatiuse.useWhen: The result is useful but should not block the current task.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The user must act before continuing or the error belongs beside a field.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: In-place editing with save, cancel, blur, announcement, and focus restoration.

whatiuse.useWhen: A visible value is changed frequently and its location should remain stable.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Validation is complex or several fields must be edited together.

items.name: reorderable-list
items.title: Reorderable List
items.description: Pointer, touch, keyboard, and screen-reader reordering with visible drop intent.

whatiuse.useWhen: Users need to change a meaningful order and the new position can be previewed and reversed.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Order is calculated, changes are destructive, or move up and down controls would be clearer for a tiny list.

items.name: action-list
items.title: Action List
items.description: Filterable keyboard-first action list with active-descendant focus.

whatiuse.useWhen: Many actions must be searched and executed without leaving keyboard flow.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The list is ordinary navigation or needs persistent multi-selection.

items.name: shared-detail
items.title: Shared Detail
items.description: Object-preserving list-to-detail transition with focus return.

whatiuse.useWhen: Users need to inspect several neighboring objects without losing list context.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The detail is a separate destination with deep navigation or a long workflow.

items.name: undo-stack
items.title: Undo Stack
items.description: LIFO reversible-action history with keyboard recovery and live announcements.

whatiuse.useWhen: A mutation can be reversed reliably without a confirmation dialog.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The inverse action is unsafe, lossy, or impossible after submission.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact monochrome metadata and removable-filter labelling.

whatiuse.useWhen: A short label adds secondary classification or compact status context.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The label triggers a primary action or contains a sentence.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Identity image, deterministic fallback, status, and grouping.

whatiuse.useWhen: Visual identity helps people recognize a person or entity faster than text alone.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: No identity exists or the image adds decoration without meaning.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Long-form input with guidance, validation, and character count.

whatiuse.useWhen: The user needs to enter more than one line of unstructured text.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The value is short or highly structured. Use Text Field or a purpose-built selector.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Accessible mutually exclusive choices with descriptions and validation.

whatiuse.useWhen: A small set of mutually exclusive options should remain visible for comparison.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The list is long or space is constrained. Use Select instead.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Short predefined selection with typeahead and collision handling.

whatiuse.useWhen: A compact control should choose one value from a short predefined list.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The option set is large enough to require filtering. Use Combobox.

items.name: context-switcher
items.title: Context Switcher
items.description: Rich single selection with icon, supporting copy, and layered flyout elevation.

whatiuse.useWhen: A short single-choice set changes the surrounding product context and each option needs an icon or one line of explanation.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The value is an ordinary form field or the option set needs filtering. Use Select or Combobox instead.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable predefined selection with empty, clear, and disabled states.

whatiuse.useWhen: A predefined collection is large enough that filtering reduces selection effort.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Free-form text should be accepted. Use Search Input or Text Field.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: Free-form native search with clear, loading, and shortcut affordances.

whatiuse.useWhen: The user enters a free-form query and results update or submit elsewhere.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The value must come from a predefined set. Use Combobox.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Semantic location hierarchy with current-page and collapsed-depth handling.

whatiuse.useWhen: Users benefit from seeing and navigating the hierarchy above the current destination.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The product is flat or the path duplicates a nearby persistent navigation tree.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Controlled, bounded, condensed page navigation.

whatiuse.useWhen: Users need stable page positions or direct access to a distant result page.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Continuous browsing is the goal and an infinite list preserves context better.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Disclosure primitive for optional supporting content and advanced settings.

whatiuse.useWhen: Supporting content is useful on demand but should not compete with the primary task.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The content is required, represents a destination, or several sections need accordion coordination.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Layout-preserving content placeholder geometry.

whatiuse.useWhen: The final layout is known and content is expected imminently.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The layout is unknown, the wait is long, or progress can be quantified.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate and indeterminate task progress with accessible status.

whatiuse.useWhen: A task duration is long enough that explicit completion feedback reduces uncertainty.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The work is effectively immediate or progress cannot be meaningfully represented.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Compact labelled ongoing-work status.

whatiuse.useWhen: Ongoing work needs a compact indicator and progress cannot be quantified.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The loading layout is large enough for a Skeleton or progress is measurable.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Persistent neutral or critical feedback with opt-in live announcement.

whatiuse.useWhen: Feedback should remain visible beside the affected work until it is understood or resolved.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The message is transient, belongs to one field, or blocks progress until a response is chosen.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Zero-result explanation with the smallest useful next action.

whatiuse.useWhen: A collection has no content and the reason or next useful action is not otherwise obvious.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Content is still loading or the empty region is too small to justify explanatory UI.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic tabular structure for product-specific sorting, filtering, and selection recipes.

whatiuse.useWhen: Rows share the same attributes and users need to scan or compare values across columns.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: Items are better understood as cards, the data is hierarchical, or responsive reading order cannot be preserved.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Headless sorting, selection, visibility, pagination, and collection states over semantic table markup.

items.name: filter-builder
items.title: Filter Builder
items.description: Visible categorical query clauses with a compact add-and-remove workflow.

items.name: data-toolbar
items.title: Data Toolbar
items.description: Saved views, query controls, and display settings in one labelled collection boundary.

items.name: bulk-action-bar
items.title: Bulk Action Bar
items.description: Selection-scoped actions that appear without moving the collection.

items.name: saved-view-menu
items.title: Saved View Menu
items.description: Named system and personal collection states with explicit management actions.

items.name: column-visibility-menu
items.title: Column Visibility Menu
items.description: Visible-column preferences with required-column protection.

items.name: facet-filter
items.title: Facet Filter
items.description: Counted multi-selection for small enumerable data dimensions.

items.name: data-sort-menu
items.title: Data Sort Menu
items.description: One explicit sort field and direction for predictable collection order.

items.name: data-group-menu
items.title: Data Group Menu
items.description: A single collection grouping dimension with an explicit clear path.

items.name: data-density-control
items.title: Data Density Control
items.description: Compact, default, and comfortable collection row rhythm.

items.name: data-result-summary
items.title: Data Result Summary
items.description: Visible, filtered, and selected record counts in one semantic status line.

items.name: cursor-pagination
items.title: Cursor Pagination
items.description: Previous and next traversal for collections without a stable total page count.

items.name: row-actions-menu
items.title: Row Actions Menu
items.description: Object-specific actions behind a consistently placed compact control.

items.name: property-list
items.title: Property List
items.description: Dense semantic label-value metadata for inspectors and detail views.

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit Log
items.description: Chronological product events with actors, targets, timestamps, and optional evidence.

items.name: data-state
items.title: Data State
items.description: Stable loading, empty, and error feedback for collection surfaces.

items.name: data-view-state
items.title: Data View State
items.description: Validated collection state, deterministic URL serialization, server request keys, and persistent personal views.

items.name: data-export
items.title: Data Export
items.description: Declared-column CSV and JSON export with safe filenames and spreadsheet formula neutralization.

items.name: date-range-filter
items.title: Date Range Filter
items.description: Draft, preset, validate, and explicitly apply an open or bounded collection date range.

items.name: data-export-menu
items.title: Data Export Menu
items.description: Export visible or selected records as CSV or JSON through one explicit collection action.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: Hierarchical navigation and selection with expansion, typeahead, and roving focus.

whatiuse.useWhen: The hierarchy itself matters and users need to expand, collapse, navigate, or select nested items.
whatiuse.avoidWhen: The content is flat, several branches must be compared at once, or ordinary disclosure sections are sufficient.

items.name: analytics
items.title: Analytics Geometry
items.description: Dependency-free domain, tick, path, formatting, and text-summary utilities for whatiuse Analytics.

items.name: whatiuse-analytics-contract
items.title: whatiuse Analytics Contract
items.description: Agent-readable component choice, state ownership, accessibility, and recipe contracts for analytic product surfaces.

items.name: whatiuse-product-patterns-contract
items.title: whatiuse Product Patterns Contract
items.description: Agent-readable task, state ownership, failure, accessibility, and composition contracts for B2B product patterns.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A compact, non-interactive directional trace for an already-labelled metric.

items.name: metric
items.title: Metric
items.description: One named value with restrained trend, comparison context, and stable loading geometry.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: An interactive ordered-series chart with synchronized pointer and keyboard inspection plus a semantic data table.

items.name: analytics-frame
items.title: Analytics Frame
items.description: Shared stable chart and semantic-table frame with loading, empty, error, and live inspection contracts.

items.name: histogram
items.title: Histogram
items.description: A pre-binned distribution with shared pointer and keyboard inspection plus an exact semantic table.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter Chart
items.description: A two-measure point view with nearest-point inspection, keyboard parity, and source data.

items.name: waterfall-chart
items.title: Waterfall Chart
items.description: Sequential gains, losses, subtotals, and totals with a visible running-value contract.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: A small part-to-whole chart with shared pointer and keyboard inspection, visible shares, and a semantic table.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A bounded multi-dimensional comparison with line-pattern redundancy and exact source values.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: One bounded measure with explicit minimum, maximum, current value, and optional target marker.

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey Chart
items.description: A compact directed-flow view with named nodes, inspectable links, and a semantic source table.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: An interactive semantic matrix for repeated intensity patterns with explicit values and two-dimensional keyboard navigation.

items.name: comparison
items.title: Comparison
items.description: Current, previous, and relative change in one compact semantic definition list.

items.name: breakdown
items.title: Breakdown
items.description: A ranked part-to-whole list with visible values and optional product selection.

items.name: goal
items.title: Goal
items.description: Progress toward one explicit target with visible actual and target values.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: Ordered stage volume with explicit adjacent conversion and optional supporting-record selection.

items.name: cohort
items.title: Cohort
items.description: A keyboard-reachable semantic retention matrix with text in every heat cell.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Dated product events that can control an analytic annotation without crowding the plot.

items.name: whatiuse-data
items.title: whatiuse Data
items.description: Three source-owned collection recipes for mutation, server data, and large immutable event streams.

items.name: whatiuse-analytics
items.title: whatiuse Analytics
items.description: Three source-owned product analytics recipes for revenue, usage, conversion, and retention decisions.

items.name: whatiuse-product-patterns
items.title: whatiuse Product Patterns
items.description: Three source-owned B2B product tasks for customer success, billing and usage, and member access.

items.name: whatiuse-agent
items.title: whatiuse Agent Contract
items.description: Machine-readable recipe selection, composition, rejection, and quality contracts for coding agents.

items.name: whatiuse
items.title: whatiuse
items.description: The 45-component whatiuse Core plus source-owned Data, Analytics, and B2B Product Patterns, with reviewed light and dark themes.
